fluff.overview: Despite the low regard most Clans hold for conventional infantry, these formations benefit from incidental access to Clan technology that makes even a disaffected garrison Point a match for its Inner Sphere equivalent. Field Gun Points are crew-served weapon teams that bring heavier firepower to the infantry level, towing weapons too large for individual soldiers to carry. The gun itself defines the Point's role, with lighter autocannons providing anti-infantry and anti-vehicle fire while heavier weapons can threaten even armored targets. The Point tows a light-caliber Clan LB-X autocannon capable of firing both solid slug and cluster munitions, providing tactical flexibility to engage both armored vehicles and dispersed infantry.
